g.text: LANTERN WELDMENT, COUPLING GUARD, INLET GASKET
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-212 Bin screw feeder (built in house, 9 off) · rev B
Non-contact: #4 or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
Ø80 H8 SPIGOT BORE (machine after welding,
coaxial Ø0.05 to the PCD 90 holes)

svg.text: P1-212-404 GUARD x2 FLAT (1:1) · 1.5 mm 304 perforated Ø5 on 8 stagger
Ø5.5 holes for M5 (H9) into the bars
reach: Ø5 holes ≥ 20 from the coupling
P1-212-501 INLET GASKET (1:2) · 3 mm FDA silicone 60A
1. Lantern: tack plates to the bars on a fixture with a Ø20 pin through both centres, weld W8 (GTAW 4 fillet both sides of each bar end),
then machine the Ø80 H8 bore and face the rear plate parallel to D within 0.1.
2. Bars carry tapped M5 holes 2 per bar (from DXF P1-212-403 pilot Ø4.2) for the guards.
3. Alignment of gearmotor to drive shaft is set by the spigots: no shims. Coupling gap 1.6 [1/16 in] per Lovejoy.
